Definition: obscuration (as if from shrinkage of light, i.e. an eclipse (only in plural)
BiblicalUsage: Kimrir is obscuration, a darkening of the light as if the sun were shrinking. Job 3:5 calls on darkness and the shadow of death to stain the day of his birth, and on the blackness of the day to terrify it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Job's eclipse is honest grief: he does not ask God to explain the darkness, he asks the darkness to cover the day he was born.
